svg.title: Filtering a turbulent velocity field
svg.desc: Left: a bell-shaped filter kernel K of width l. Right: a velocity profile with structure on many scales (black), its filtered part, a smooth large-scale wave (blue), and the small-scale fluctuations left over (red), which oscillate around zero.

g.font-family: 'Latin Modern Math', 'STIX Two Math', 'Cambria Math', serif
